name: Sealmatic India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, Sealmatic India Ltd manufactures mechanical seals, seal supply systems, pumps, valves, motors and high precision mechanical engineering spares and assemblies[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SIL is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, etc. certified company which designs and manufactures engineered mechanical seals and sealing support systems, used in rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, mixers, steam turbines and other speciality equipment

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 26.2% CAGR over last 5 years
